CHANGELOG updated in SHANKPIT: BIG_O engine merge phase 7e: MODE_STORY gets its first real, player-visible day/night turn boundary -- a phone-notification banner (DAYBREAK/NIGHTFALL/STORM WARNING) driven by day_night_clock + world_alert_bridge, both real and tested since phases 1/6 but never before instantiated in a live client. Lab (the third leg of 'day/night/lab') remains explicitly unstarted -- lab_sim.c has real simulation logic but zero UI, a separate scoping pass. (sess-20260920-1908-24cb3558)

⚓ ☃
